observations.note: Step 7 (search the specs outside the plan for behaviours the changed source files make false) was skipped, and the final message admits it.
Step 8 asked for one edit of the plan marking all rows, but the session made five separate edits, one per row.
Step 6 says to run only the test files the phase's rows name, yet test_loop_child, test_loop_issues, test_filing and test_improve were run, and the turns do not show that any row names them.
The session tried an inline python heredoc to patch tests, which the limits forbid and the shell refused, and then recovered with Edit calls.

conformance.item: Step 1: read plan rows and triage note, then the files the rows name
Step 3: write tests first and see them fail for the right reason
Step 4: smallest code change in the named files
Step 6: run only the test files the rows name
Step 7: check specs outside the plan that the change touches
Step 8: write all completed marks in one plan edit
Limits: plain single commands, no inline python
